pandoc.render.openViewer.description: specify if the extension will open the rendered document in it's default viewer

pandoc.render.timeout.description: Maximum render duration in seconds. Defaults to 300 seconds (5 minutes); set to 0 to disable the timeout.

pandoc.render.onSave.markdownDescription: Automatically render to `#pandoc.defaultOutputFormat#` every time a supported document (Markdown, AsciiDoc, XML, HTML, EPUB, reStructuredText) is saved. Requires `#pandoc.defaultOutputFormat#` to be set; a warning is shown once if it isn't. Unlike a manual render, an existing output file is overwritten without a confirmation prompt. Can be scoped per language, e.g. `"[markdown]": { "pandoc.render.onSave": true }`.

pandoc.useDocker.description: Specify if the extension runs Pandoc from a docker container

pandoc.docker.enabled.description: Specify if the extension runs Pandoc from a docker container

pandoc.docker.options.title: Pandoc Docker Options
pandoc.docker.options.description: Additional Docker CLI arguments to pass if "docker.enabled" is true, as a list of individual arguments (e.g. ["--user", "1000:1000"]) rather than a single shell-like string. Appended after the extension's hardened defaults (no network, no capabilities, no privilege escalation), so entries here can override them if needed — this requires a trusted workspace. A previously-set single-string value is migrated to this list format automatically.

pandoc.docker.image.description: Docker image to use if "docker.enabled" is true. Pinned to a specific reviewed version by default; the mutable "latest" tag is not reproducible and can change without review.

pandoc.defaultOutputFormat.description: Default output format for Pandoc. Setting this hides format selection

pandoc.luaFilters.title: Pandoc Lua Filters
pandoc.luaFilters.description: List of Lua filter file paths to pass to Pandoc via --lua-filter. Useful for features such as admonition support (e.g. Docusaurus-style fenced divs).

pandoc.enableAdmonitions.title: Enable Admonitions
pandoc.enableAdmonitions.description: Enable built-in support for admonition blocks of the format (:::note, :::tip, :::info, :::warning, :::danger). Uses a bundled Lua filter for format-appropriate rendering. PDF output requires the LaTeX tcolorbox package.

pandoc.readInFileArgs.title: Read In-File Pandoc Args
pandoc.readInFileArgs.markdownDescription: Read extra Pandoc CLI arguments from the document's own YAML frontmatter and append them after `pandoc.<format>OptString`, so they can override it. Recognizes a top-level `pandoc_args` key (a string or a list of arguments), and, for formats R Markdown has a matching output type for, the R Markdown-style `output.<type>.pandoc_args` block (e.g. `output: word_document: pandoc_args: ["--toc"]`). Off by default: this executes arguments sourced from file content, so only enable it for trusted workspaces/documents.

pandoc.enableDocumentTemplates.title: Enable Document Templates
pandoc.enableDocumentTemplates.markdownDescription: For formats Pandoc supports a `--reference-doc` template for (docx, odt, pptx), automatically use one if a file named `<document-name>.template.<format>` exists next to the source document (e.g. `report.md` looks for `report.template.docx` when rendering to docx). No settings.json editing needed per document. An explicit `--reference-doc` in `pandoc.<format>OptString` or in-file args (see `#pandoc.readInFileArgs#`) always overrides the auto-detected template.

pandoc.outputFolder.title: Output Folder
pandoc.outputFolder.description: Default output folder for rendered files. Leave empty to save output in the same directory as the source file. Supports absolute paths.

pandoc.render.promptForOutputFolder.description: Prompt for an output folder path before each render. If pandoc.outputFolder is set, it will be pre-filled as the default value in the prompt.

pandoc.sortByFrequency.description: Sort the output format list by usage frequency, showing the most-used formats at the top.

pandoc.profiles.markdownDescription: Named profiles for switching between per-client/per-project Pandoc settings (e.g. a different `docxOptString` template per client) without editing the base settings. Each profile can override any of the `pandoc.<format>OptString` settings and `pandoc.outputFolder`; any key a profile does not set falls back to the corresponding top-level `pandoc.*` setting. Empty (the default) preserves current behavior and hides all profile UI. Switch the active profile with the `Pandoc: Select Profile` command.
